symbols.name: input length
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in each input string.
symbols.quote: Let $n$ be the number of bits in each input.

symbols.name: first input
symbols.meaning: The first binary input string, of length $n$.
symbols.quote: Let $x$ be the first binary string, of length $n$.

symbols.name: second input
symbols.meaning: The second binary input string, of length $n$.
symbols.quote: Let $y$ be the second binary string, also of length $n$.
